pairs.source: Your hero kept training in the dark.
Offline progress grants XP and combat Gold only. Items, bosses, and zone progress are not simulated.
pairs.target: 离线进度只获得经验和战斗金币，不模拟物品、首领和区域进度。

pairs.source: Drops kept by the filter appear here.
pairs.target: 过滤器保留的战利品会出现在这里。

pairs.source: A steady road for an untested build.
pairs.target: 适合尚未验证构筑的平稳道路。

pairs.source: The dead endure. Your gear must answer.
pairs.target: 亡者仍在坚持，你的装备必须回应。

pairs.source: Only a proven build can hold the line.
pairs.target: 只有成熟构筑才能守住防线。

pairs.source: Iron yields before the trial does.
pairs.target: 钢铁会比试炼更早屈服。
每场胜利都要收取代价。

pairs.source: The pit has learned your name.
pairs.target: 黑坑已经记住了你的名字。
仁慈无法抵达如此深处。
护甲在灰烬下逐渐变薄。
只有最坚韧的构筑能够坚持。

pairs.source: The last defenses begin to fail.
Endure what should not be endured.
pairs.target: 忍受本不该被承受的一切。

pairs.source: A chapel hammer whose bell head splits armor on the backswing.
pairs.target: 一柄礼拜堂战锤，钟形锤头在回摆时劈裂护甲。

pairs.source: Chapel brass and ash shaped into a crown that remembers the bell.
pairs.target: 礼拜堂黄铜与灰烬铸成的王冠，仍记得钟声。

pairs.source: Brass chapel plates packed with ash and cracked bell metal.
pairs.target: 礼拜堂黄铜甲片，填满灰烬与碎裂的钟铜。

pairs.source: A cracked chapel case packed with ash and sealed wax.
pairs.target: 一只开裂的礼拜堂圣匣，装满灰烬，以蜡封缄。

pairs.source: A chapel seal pressed through wax after the candles died.
pairs.target: 一枚礼拜堂印戒，在烛火熄灭后压入蜡封。

pairs.source: A pit stone clamped in iron, warm after every kill.
pairs.target: 一块以铁箍住的黑坑之石，每次击杀后都会发热。

pairs.source: A two-hand cleaver lashed with bone hooks from old cemetery gates.
pairs.target: 一把双手砍刀，绑着取自旧墓园大门的骨钩。

pairs.source: A furnace-edged warblade with ember teeth along the spine.
pairs.target: 一把熔炉锻刃的战刃，刃背排列着余烬之齿。

pairs.source: An asymmetrical bone crest wired over old crypt leather and iron.
pairs.target: 一顶不对称的骨冠，以铁丝缠在旧墓穴皮革与铁件上。

pairs.source: A stone-headed sledge that leaves wet cracks in old armor.
pairs.target: 一把石头锤头的重锤，在旧护甲上留下湿漉漉的裂痕。

pairs.source: A wet stone totem with one gate notch from the crypt floor.
pairs.target: 一座湿冷的石图腾，带着一道取自墓穴地面的门形刻痕。

pairs.source: A wet iron ring with red glass set too deep to dry.
pairs.target: 一枚湿铁戒指，红玻璃嵌得太深，永远不会干。

pairs.source: A broad crypt sword with a drowned gate pattern along the fuller.
pairs.target: 一把宽刃墓穴剑，血槽上刻着沉没之门的纹路。

pairs.source: Wet iron plates sealed into a faceguard from the crypt floor.
pairs.target: 取自墓穴地面的湿铁片，封合成一副面甲。

pairs.source: Wet iron rings over a sealed breastplate from the crypt floor.
pairs.target: 湿铁环覆于取自墓穴地面的密封胸甲之上。

pairs.source: A long farm sword, rusted flat where the fields dragged it.
pairs.target: 一把农家长剑，在田间拖行之处锈得平钝。

pairs.source: A grave nail lashed to bone so it cannot be lost.
pairs.target: 一根绑在骨头上的墓钉，以免遗失。

pairs.source: A reinforced burial hood with an iron brow and one bone clasp.
pairs.target: 一顶加固的裹尸兜帽，配有铁制眉甲和一枚骨扣。

pairs.source: Layered cemetery hide set with chipped grave-stone plates.
pairs.target: 层叠的墓园兽皮，镶着崩缺的墓碑石片。

pairs.source: A cemetery maul capped with cracked stone and grave-nails.
pairs.target: 一把墓园巨锤，锤头是开裂的石块，嵌满墓钉。

pairs.source: A cemetery signet polished only where old fingers failed.
pairs.target: 一枚墓园印戒，只在旧主手指无力之处被磨亮。

pairs.source: A light leather helm cracked with mud and tied with dead grass.
pairs.target: 一顶轻皮盔，布满泥裂，用枯草系紧。

pairs.source: A plain rusted field band worn smooth by work and mud.
pairs.target: 一枚朴素的锈蚀田间指环，被劳作与泥土磨得光滑。

pairs.source: A two-hand field axe with a mud-black edge and harvest-hook bite.
pairs.target: 一把双手田斧，刃口泥黑，咬合如收割钩。

pairs.source: Field straps and boiled leather, hardened with old mud and rusted rivets.
pairs.target: 田间皮带与煮硬的皮革，以陈泥和锈铆钉加固。

pairs.source: Black iron clenches one coal that refuses to cool.
pairs.target: 黑铁紧扣着一块不肯冷却的煤。

pairs.source: Heavy black iron armor with ember seams and furnace-burned edges.
pairs.target: 厚重的黑铁护甲，接缝透着余烬，边缘被炉火烧焦。

pairs.source: A furnace-black mask made to keep its wearer facing forward.
pairs.target: 一副炉火熏黑的面具，迫使佩戴者只能直面前方。

pairs.source: A two-hand pit maul of black iron, built for one brutal swing.
pairs.target: 一把黑铁铸成的双手坑锤，只为一记残暴的挥击而生。

pairs.source: A mud idol tied from field scraps and dead grass.
pairs.target: 一尊用田间碎料和枯草扎成的泥偶。

pairs.source: A longblade sealed with candle wax and ash around the grip.
pairs.target: 一把长刃，握柄处以烛蜡和灰烬封住。

pairs.source: A worn two-hand axe kept sharp enough for the first field.
pairs.target: 一把旧双手斧，仍锋利得足以应付第一片田野。
+10% 攻击速度 | +10% 精英伤害
+14% 最大生命 | +1 生命恢复
+22% 最大生命 | +14% 精英伤害
解锁：出售普通物品过滤

pairs.source: The blade remembers the way back.
Each main fire front echoes after {0} s for {1}% damage. Echoes do not trigger other skill effects.
pairs.target: 每道主要火焰波在{0}秒后以{1}%伤害回响。回响不触发其他技能效果。

pairs.source: Its edge remembers the thickness of gravestones.
Fire Cleave becomes a piercing strip: width {0}× base radius, length {1}× range, speed {2} m/s. Main fronts hit each enemy once per cast.
pairs.target: 烈焰劈斩变为穿透火带：宽度为基础半径的{0}倍，长度为射程的{1}倍，速度为{2}米/秒。每次施放的主波对每个敌人只命中一次。

pairs.source: Stone dust still grinds against the axe's spine.
pairs.target: 斧背仍有石粉沙沙作响。

pairs.source: Each main Whirlwind pulse adds an outer ring up to {0}× radius for {1}% damage.
pairs.target: 旋风的每次主要脉冲增加一个外环，最远达到半径的{0}倍，造成{1}%伤害。

pairs.source: Heat spills from the cracks of a cold forge.
pairs.target: 熄灭炉火的余热从裂隙中洒落。

pairs.source: During Whirlwind, every {0} m leaves a burning patch: radius {1} m, lasts {2} s, deals {4}% damage every {3} s. Up to {5} patches.
pairs.target: 旋风期间每移动{0}米留下火焰区域：半径{1}米，持续{2}秒，每{3}秒造成{4}%伤害。最多{5}处。

pairs.source: Each blow wakes what lies below.
pairs.target: 每次敲击都唤醒地下之物。

pairs.source: After landing, seismic pulses deal {2}% of the total skill damage every {1} s for {0} s. They cannot stun again or trigger other effects.
pairs.target: 落地后，每隔{1}秒产生一次地震脉冲，造成技能总伤害的{2}%，持续{0}秒。不再次昏迷，也不触发其他效果。

pairs.source: Old iron opens wounds that never closed.
pairs.target: 旧铁撕开尚未愈合的伤口。

pairs.source: The main Seismic Leap hit consumes surviving enemies' existing bleed once, dealing {0}% of its remaining damage immediately.
pairs.target: 撼地跃击的主击一次性消耗存活敌人原有的流血，立即造成其剩余伤害的{0}%。

pairs.source: A small flame trembles in the empty socket.
pairs.target: 空眼窝中颤动着一簇微火。

pairs.source: Main direct hits against enemies at full health always critically hit.
pairs.target: 对满生命敌人的主要直接攻击必定暴击。

pairs.source: Stand still, and the iron hears danger coming.
After standing still for {0} s, blocks the next incoming hit. Movement removes the block. Cooldown: {1} s.
pairs.target: 静止{0}秒后格挡下一次攻击。移动会移除防护。冷却：{1}秒。

pairs.source: Its thorns grow toward the coming blow.
pairs.target: 尖刺迎着来袭的打击生长。

pairs.source: Losing health to a direct hit strikes the attacker for {0}% of hero Damage. Cooldown: {1} s.
pairs.target: 因直接攻击损失生命时，对攻击者造成英雄伤害属性的{0}%。冷却：{1}秒。

pairs.source: Wax seals the cracks while the heart still beats.
pairs.target: 心脏仍在跳动，蜡便封住裂缝。

pairs.source: Excess regeneration and Life Steal become a shield, up to {0}% of maximum health.
pairs.target: 生命再生和生命偷取的溢出治疗转化为护盾，上限为最大生命的{0}%。

pairs.source: Every notch demands a red signature.
pairs.target: 每道刻痕都索要一枚鲜红签名。

pairs.source: Main critical hits cause bleed for {0} s. Each tick deals the higher of Bleed Damage or {1}% of the hit's damage.
pairs.target: 主要暴击造成持续{0}秒的流血。每跳伤害取流血伤害与该次命中伤害的{1}%中较高者。

pairs.source: Forged by the hermit lich Ainz for his decurion. The blood it takes from the living keeps the dead ranks on their feet.
pairs.target: 隐居巫妖安兹为其十夫长所铸。它从生者身上夺来的血，让亡者的队列屹立不倒。

pairs.source: Bleed ticks gain the hero's Life Steal and share the area-healing limit.
pairs.target: 流血每跳获得英雄的生命偷取，并共享范围治疗上限。

pairs.source: The flame goes out one heartbeat late.
pairs.target: 火焰比心跳晚一步熄灭。

pairs.source: A lethal hit leaves 1 HP and grants immunity for {0} s. Cooldown: {1} s of gameplay.
pairs.target: 致命一击留下1点生命，并提供{0}秒无敌。冷却：{1}秒游戏时间。

pairs.source: A hungry glow still stirs beneath the ash.
pairs.target: 灰烬下仍有饥饿的余热。

pairs.source: Kills with a main direct hit cause a {0} m explosion for {1}% of hero Damage. Cooldown: {2} s.
pairs.target: 主要直接攻击击杀敌人时，引发半径{0}米的爆炸，造成英雄伤害属性的{1}%。冷却：{2}秒。
